name: smo
description: The SMO vertical-slice test run. Same seats as 'verify', but the acceptance criteria are hand-written rather than generated - see Docs/SmoTestRun.md section 3.
criteria: The deliverable is the production bible itself, not a plan or outline of one.
It covers exactly the named slice, and explicitly states what is out of scope.
Every factual claim about SMO is traceable to the source description, and gaps are marked 'not specified in source' rather than filled in.
Every design decision originating in the deliverable is marked as a proposal with a stated reason.
It contains an itemised, countable asset list.
It contains acceptance criteria that decide the slice is done.
It contains no schedule, timeline, headcount or cost estimate.
It contains no praise of the project and no pitch language.
